measurement.title: Setting Up a scaffold In The City

notes:
How Loud Is Setting Up a Scaffold?

It is an everyday sight on a city street — but how much noise does building a scaffold actually generate?

This SPL Reference measurement captures workers assembling scaffolding alongside an urban road. Metal poles and fittings being moved, positioned and struck create repeated sharp impacts, mixed with traffic and the normal background of the city.

What makes this sound particularly noticeable is not necessarily a continuous high level, but the succession of sudden metallic peaks interrupting the surrounding ambience.

A good example of how an ordinary urban activity can temporarily transform the acoustic character of a street.

Environment: Urban street
Activity: Scaffold assembly
Soundscape: Metallic impacts, construction activity and road traffic
Measurement type: Real-world urban / construction noise
